rows.source: Airtel Africa plc Annual Report and Accounts 2024, consolidated statement of financial position, printed page 184 (PDF page 186), columns 31 March 2024 and 31 March 2023, US$ millions. periods_note: columns dropped: FY2024, FY2023, FY2022 - no row in this file carries a figure for them, so they rendered as pure dashes
currencyNote: Airtel Africa reports in US dollars; the NGX doclib filing it is taken from is a USD statement. The share price quoted on the NGX is in naira and that is correct in the market record - only the statements are USD. Corrected because mixing a naira price with dollar earnings misstates every ratio by roughly the exchange rate.
